title: A Guess About Distance Is Worth Half the Search
summary: Step two shortest-path searches through a maze one expansion at a time and watch a rough distance estimate halve the work without costing a step of path.

sources.title: Hart, Nilsson & Raphael (1968), A Formal Basis for the Heuristic Determination of Minimum Cost Paths
Amit Patel, Introduction to A* — Red Blob Games
